description: Enhanced publish-failure coverage for batch sends: when the client rejects a multi-topic batch, every span created for the batch is marked error with the client failure reason, the batch action line reports the neutral failure category, and each outgoing message still carries its injected span context.

cases.expected_output:
produce_batch status=error error=client_send_failure
inject msg=0 carries=span#0
inject msg=1 carries=span#1
inject msg=2 carries=span#2
spans=3
span 0 kind=producer name=topic-a trace=t0 parent=root status=error
  status_message=batch send rejected by broker
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-a
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
span 1 kind=producer name=topic-a trace=t1 parent=root status=error
  status_message=batch send rejected by broker
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-a
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
span 2 kind=producer name=topic-b trace=t2 parent=root status=error
  status_message=batch send rejected by broker
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-b
  messaging.destination_kind=topic

produce_batch status=error error=client_send_failure
inject msg=0 carries=span#0
spans=1
span 0 kind=producer name=solo trace=t0 parent=root status=error
  status_message=single batch failure
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=solo
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
